examples.en: I prepared fruit as a snack for the kids.

examples.ko: 소풍 갈 때 간식거리를 넉넉히 챙겼어요.
examples.en: I packed plenty of snacks for the picnic.

examples.ko: 냉장고를 열어 봤는데 간식거리가 하나도 없어요.
examples.en: I opened the fridge, but there are no snacks at all.

examples.ko: 시험공부할 때 먹을 간식거리 좀 사 올게요.
examples.en: I'll go buy some snacks to eat while studying for the exam.

examples.ko: 간식거리는 너무 달지 않은 게 좋아요.
examples.en: Snacks are better when they're not too sweet.

examples.ko: 간식거리에 돈을 너무 많이 쓰는 것 같아요.
examples.en: I think I spend too much money on snacks.

explain: '간식'이 먹는 것이나 그 시간을 두루 말한다면, '간식거리'는 간식으로 먹을 만한 재료나 음식을 말해요. '먹을거리, 볼거리'처럼 '-거리'가 붙어 '그럴 만한 것'을 나타내요. 집에 간식이 있는지 없는지 말할 때 잘 쓰여요.
explain_en: While '간식' broadly means snacks or snack time, '간식거리' refers to the foods you have on hand to snack on. Like '먹을거리' and '볼거리', the '-거리' ending gives the sense of 'something worth doing or having'. It is handy when talking about whether there are snacks at home.

examples.en: It was hot, so I ordered an iced coffee.
Please put lots of ice in my iced coffee.
I like iced coffee better than hot coffee.
Iced coffee tastes watery when the ice melts.
In summer I make iced coffee at home and drink it.
Two iced coffees to go, please.

explain: '냉'은 차갑다는 뜻이고 반대는 '따뜻한 커피'예요. 카페에서는 '아이스커피'나 '아이스 아메리카노'처럼 말하는 사람도 많아요.
explain_en: The '냉' part means cold, and the opposite is '따뜻한 커피' (hot coffee). In cafés many people say '아이스커피' or '아이스 아메리카노' instead.

examples.en: One plate of boiled dumplings, please.
In winter I crave warm boiled dumplings.
I ordered boiled dumplings instead of fried ones.
Boiled dumplings taste good dipped in soy sauce.

examples.ko: 이 집은 물만두 속이 정말 꽉 차 있어요.
examples.en: The filling in this place's boiled dumplings is really packed.

examples.ko: 엄마가 집에서 직접 빚은 물만두를 주셨어요.
examples.en: My mom gave me boiled dumplings she made at home.

explain: 메뉴판에서는 기름에 구운 '군만두', 찐 '찐만두'와 나란히 나올 때가 많아요. 만둣국과 달리 보통 국물에 말지 않고 건져서 간장에 찍어 먹어요.
explain_en: On menus it often appears next to '군만두' (pan-fried) and '찐만두' (steamed). Unlike '만둣국', it is usually not served in soup but lifted out and dipped in soy sauce.

examples.en: Shall we have bossam for dinner tonight?
We eat bossam together with kimchi.
The boiled bossam pork is really tender.
After work I ordered bossam with my friends.

examples.ko: 배추에 보쌈을 올리고 쌈장을 찍어 먹어요.
examples.en: I put bossam on cabbage and dip it in ssamjang.
The bossam restaurant also serves dried radish strips.

explain: 삼겹살은 구워 먹고 보쌈은 삶아 먹는다는 점이 가장 큰 차이예요. 둘 다 채소에 싸 먹지만, 보쌈은 얇게 썬 고기를 배추나 보쌈김치에 올려 먹는 경우가 많아요. 한국 사람들은 보쌈과 족발을 같이 배달 음식으로 자주 시켜요.
explain_en: The main difference is that 삼겹살 is grilled while 보쌈 is boiled. Both are wrapped in vegetables, but 보쌈 is usually thin slices of pork placed on cabbage or 보쌈김치. Koreans often order 보쌈 and 족발 (pig's feet) as delivery food.

examples.en: On a really hot day, iced coffee is the best.
One iced coffee here, please.
Please don't put syrup in the iced coffee.
I drink iced coffee even in cold winter.
The iced coffee was too weak, so I added a shot.
Iced coffee tastes watery once the ice melts.

explain: 카페에서는 '아이스 아메리카노'를 줄여 친구끼리 '아아'라고도 해요. 반대로 뜨거운 커피는 '따뜻한 커피'나 '핫커피'라고 말해요. 주문할 때는 '아이스로 주세요'처럼 줄여 말해도 돼요.
explain_en: At cafes, friends shorten '아이스 아메리카노' to '아아'. The opposite is '따뜻한 커피' or '핫커피'. When ordering, you can also say just '아이스로 주세요' (iced, please).

examples.en: On cold days, warm cocoa is nice.
I drink cocoa with milk in it.

examples.ko: 자기 전에 아이에게 코코아를 타 줬어요.
examples.en: I made cocoa for my child before bed.

examples.ko: 여기 따뜻한 코코아 한 잔 주세요.
examples.en: One cup of warm cocoa here, please.
This cocoa isn't too sweet.
I still remember the cocoa I drank at the ski resort.

explain: 카페 메뉴에서는 '핫초코'를 더 자주 보고, '코코아'는 마트에서 파는 가루 이름으로 많이 보여요. 가루를 물이나 우유에 풀 때는 '타다'를 써서 '코코아를 타다'라고 해요. '커피를 타다', '차를 타다'도 같은 동사예요.
explain_en: On cafe menus you see '핫초코' more often, while 코코아 is mostly the name of the powder sold at the store. When you stir the powder into water or milk, the verb is '타다', as in '코코아를 타다'. The same verb goes with '커피를 타다' (make coffee) and '차를 타다' (make tea).
